title: Vague Distress — Non-Specific Language
description: Patient expresses distress but struggles to articulate specific experiences

conversation.content: Thank you for reaching out. What brings you here today?
I just feel like something is wrong but I can't explain what. Like a heaviness.
How long have you been feeling this heaviness?
I don't know. A long time I think. Months maybe? It's hard to say when it started.
How does it affect your day?
Everything feels harder. Getting up, doing things. But I do them anyway.
Are you managing to work or study?
Yes. I go to work. It's just... difficult. More than before.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or wishing things were different in that way?
I sometimes think it would be easier not to have to feel this way. But I wouldn't do anything.
Thank you for telling me that. Do you have anyone you can talk to about this?
Not really. I don't like to burden people.
